title: Does Pedro die in Quem Ama Cuida? Lawyer's car sabotaged
seoTitle: Does Pedro Die in Quem Ama Cuida? Car Sabotage
subtitle: Pilar orchestrates hit and tries to eliminate Pedro to protect Adriana
excerpt: In Quem Ama Cuida, tensions rise as Pilar orders Tom to sabotage the car of Pedro, Adriana's lawyer.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In Globo's 9 PM telenovela, things take a tense turn when Pilar decides that Pedro, Adriana's lawyer, must be eliminated. To do so, she orders Tom to place a tracker on the lawyer's vehicle and then stage a collision that runs the car off the road and into a river.

Pilar orchestrates attack on Pedro

Pilar (Isabel Teixeira) fears that Adriana (Letícia Colin) will be acquitted and reclaim her inheritance. To prevent this, she decides to kill the lawyer defending her rival.

Tom executes the sabotage plan

Tom (Allan Souza Lima) crawls under Pedro's car, installs a tracking device, and later positions the criminals' vehicle near the lawyer at a gas station. While Pedro is driving, the collision occurs, sending the car off the road and into the river.

Pedro survives and is saved by Iuri and Adriana

Chay Suede's character is trapped in the wreckage, but does not die. He is taken to the hospital in critical condition and, thanks to the intervention of Adriana and Iuri (José Loreto), manages to recover.

Secrets revealed after the attack

After the accident, Pedro begins to suspect Pilar. He confronts Tom, who reveals that Pilar asked Ademir to try to bribe him during Adriana's trial. The case puts Pilar in a complicated situation, as her own plan may have backfired on her.

Tom and Pilar in a secret relationship

On October 17, Iuri reveals to Pedro and Adriana that Pilar and Tom are having an affair. The discovery adds more layers of intrigue to the plot, as the duo that orchestrated the attack also shares a romantic bond.

With information from Notícias da TV, Capricho.
